lines.zh: 我一步跨过三棵小树，树都弯了。
lines.en: One stride carries me over three saplings; they bend.

lines.zh: 树枝做的腿踩下去，地面闷响。
lines.en: My branch-made legs come down with a muffled thud.

lines.zh: 我穿过林子，鸟全飞走了。
lines.en: I cross the woods, and every bird takes flight.

lines.zh: 头上的枝杈挂住藤蔓，我随手扯开。
lines.en: Vines snag on my branchy crown; I tear them loose.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，可一步抵你十步。
lines.en: I walk slowly, but one step equals ten of yours.

lines.zh: 落叶在我脚下碎成粉。
lines.en: Fallen leaves crumble to dust beneath my feet.

lines.zh: 我沿着林线走，影子盖住半片草地。
lines.en: I walk the treeline, my shadow covering half the grass.

lines.zh: 我的肩膀擦过树干，树皮掉了一层。
lines.en: My shoulder scrapes a trunk and strips its bark.

lines.zh: 我转身时，周围的小树都被推倒。
lines.en: When I turn, the saplings around me fall.

lines.zh: 树根从我脚踝处拖着土。
lines.en: Roots drag soil from around my ankles.

lines.zh: 我不绕路，直接踩过倒木。
lines.en: I do not go around; I trample straight over the log.

lines.zh: 森林让开一条道给我。
lines.en: The trees part and let me pass through.

lines.zh: 我抬脚时，泥里留下一个坑。
lines.en: When I lift a foot, a pit remains in the mud.

lines.zh: 我朝有光的地方走，那里树稀。
lines.en: I walk toward the light, where the trees thin out.

lines.zh: 我踩断的树枝在脚下咔嚓响。
lines.en: The branches I break snap under my feet.

lines.zh: 林子那头有动静，我转过去。
lines.en: Something stirs at the far treeline; I turn that way.

lines.zh: 我站着不动，就像一棵老树。
lines.en: Standing still, I am just an old tree.

lines.zh: 有只松鼠爬上我的手臂，又跑了。
lines.en: A squirrel climbs my arm and then runs off.

lines.zh: 我的关节在响，像树枝被风折。
lines.en: My joints creak like branches snapping in wind.

lines.zh: 我在等，等林子安静下来。
lines.en: I am waiting for the woods to grow quiet.

lines.zh: 苔藓从我肩上长出来，我不在意。
lines.en: Moss grows on my shoulder, and I do not mind.

lines.zh: 我数着自己的年轮，数不过来。
lines.en: I try to count my rings and cannot finish.

lines.zh: 风吹过我的枝冠，声音像我自己的呼吸。
lines.en: Wind through my crown sounds like my own breathing.

lines.zh: 我把手插进土里，站得更稳。
lines.en: I push my hand into the soil and stand firmer.

lines.zh: 林子里没什么敢靠近我。
lines.en: Nothing in these woods dares come near.

lines.zh: 我低头看一只鹿，它立刻跑了。
lines.en: I look down at a deer, and it bolts at once.

lines.zh: 我不需要睡，只需要站着。
lines.en: I need no sleep, only to stand.

lines.zh: 我的影子慢慢移，日头也慢慢移。
lines.en: My shadow creeps, and so does the sun.

lines.zh: 你站在我的树荫边，太显眼了。
lines.en: You stand at the edge of my shade — far too noticeable.

lines.zh: 我低头看你，你比我的脚还矮。
lines.en: I look down; you are shorter than my foot.

lines.zh: 你的斧头，我隔着树也看得清。
lines.en: I can make out your axe even through the trees.

lines.zh: 你身上有木头的味道，我不喜欢。
lines.en: You smell of cut wood, and I dislike it.

lines.zh: 我看了你很久，你却没有走。
lines.en: I have watched you a long while, and you have not left.

lines.zh: 你抬头的样子，像在找一棵树。
lines.en: You look up as if searching for a tree.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在树皮缝里，很难被找到。
lines.en: My eyes sit in bark crevices, hard to find.

lines.zh: 你在估我的高度，我也在估你。
lines.en: You gauge my height; I gauge you.

lines.zh: 别站在两棵树之间，那是我要踩的地方。
lines.en: Do not stand between two trees; that is where I step.

lines.zh: 你看我的时候，整个林子都静了。
lines.en: When you look at me, the whole forest quiets.

lines.zh: 你砍进我的树皮，砍得不深。
lines.en: You cut into my bark, and not deeply.

lines.zh: 疼，但树不会因为疼就倒。
lines.en: It hurts, but a tree does not fall from pain.

lines.zh: 我的枝子断了一根，还会再长。
lines.en: One of my branches broke; it will grow back.

lines.zh: 你这一下，让我认真起来了。
lines.en: That blow has made me take this seriously.

lines.zh: 木头碎屑落下来，像下了一场雨。
lines.en: Splinters fall from me like a shower of rain.

lines.zh: 我的树皮有十层厚，你慢慢砍。
lines.en: My bark is ten layers thick; keep chopping.

lines.zh: 你打中的地方，正长着苔藓。
lines.en: You struck the spot where moss grows.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，林子也跟着响。
lines.en: I take half a step back and the woods echo.

lines.zh: 疼是有的，可我比你想的结实。
lines.en: There is pain, but I am tougher than you think.

lines.zh: 再砍，我就把你按进土里。
lines.en: Chop again and I will press you into the soil.

lines.zh: 你手里那截原木，从哪砍的？
lines.en: That log in your hand — where did you cut it?

lines.zh: 一株小树苗，我愿意为它弯下腰。
lines.en: For a sapling, I am willing to bend down.

lines.zh: 雨水落在根上，我就迈不动步。
lines.en: Rain on my roots and I cannot take a step.

lines.zh: 那片林子的土很肥，我一直记着。
lines.en: That grove's soil is rich; I keep thinking of it.

lines.zh: 你把木头放下，我就当你赔罪。
lines.en: Set the wood down and I will call it an apology.

lines.zh: 我不吃，可我喜欢新木的气味。
lines.en: I do not eat, but I love the smell of fresh wood.

lines.zh: 有棵老树倒了，我想去看看。
lines.en: An old tree has fallen, and I want to see it.

lines.zh: 你身上带着树脂香，走近些。
lines.en: You carry the scent of resin; come closer.

lines.zh: 这地方的树太矮，我待不久。
lines.en: The trees here are too short; I will not stay long.

lines.zh: 我听见斧声，就忍不住朝那边走。
lines.en: Hear an axe, and I cannot help walking toward it.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的膝盖，像撞一堵墙。
lines.en: You run into my knee as if into a wall.

lines.zh: 我的手臂扫过树冠，叶子落了一地。
lines.en: My arm sweeps the canopy and leaves fall everywhere.

lines.zh: 我转过身，肩头把你顶开了。
lines.en: I turn, and my shoulder pushes you aside.

lines.zh: 你退得太慢，撞在我膝上。
lines.en: You retreat too slowly and hit my knee.

lines.zh: 这一下我没使劲，你却飞了出去。
lines.en: I put no force into it, yet you flew.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，我只晃了一下。
lines.en: We collided, and I only swayed.

lines.zh: 你的盾撞上我的树皮，响了一声。
lines.en: Your shield strikes my bark with a single knock.

lines.zh: 我踩到你的脚，抱歉，我没看见。
lines.en: I stepped on your foot — sorry, I did not see.

lines.zh: 我走一步，你就得退三步。
lines.en: I take one step, and you must take three back.

lines.zh: 别再挤过来了，我的根在下面。
lines.en: Stop crowding me; my roots are underneath.

lines.zh: 这片林子只有我一棵会走。
lines.en: I am the only walking tree in these woods.

lines.zh: 你也是木头做的吗？让我看看年轮。
lines.en: Are you made of wood too? Let me see your rings.

lines.zh: 两棵树站在一起，风就吹不倒了。
lines.en: Two trees standing together cannot be blown down.

lines.zh: 我会把最直的枝子留给你。
lines.en: I will keep my straightest branch for you.

lines.zh: 我们不说话，只并排站着。
lines.en: We need no words; we only stand side by side.

lines.zh: 我的根和你的根缠在一起就好。
lines.en: It is enough that my roots twine with yours.

lines.zh: 我走了很久，才遇到另一个会动的。
lines.en: I walked a long way before meeting another that moves.

lines.zh: 春天的雨水会先落在你那边。
lines.en: The spring rain will fall on your side first.

lines.zh: 你若是树，我们有一百年可等。
lines.en: If you are a tree, we have a century to wait.

lines.zh: 我把这片林子的边界分你一半。
lines.en: I give you half the bounds of this forest.

lines.zh: 我捡不起小东西，指头太粗。
lines.en: I cannot pick up small things; my fingers are too thick.

lines.zh: 一截断枝，我把它插回土里。
lines.en: A broken branch — I push it back into the soil.

lines.zh: 这块石头太小，我捏了一下就碎了。
lines.en: This stone is so small it crumbles in my grip.

lines.zh: 我抱起整根倒木，像抱一根柴。
lines.en: I lift a whole fallen trunk like a stick of firewood.

lines.zh: 你掉的斧头，我拿在手里太轻。
lines.en: The axe you dropped feels weightless in my hand.

lines.zh: 我把东西放下时，地面震了一下。
lines.en: When I set the thing down, the ground shakes once.

lines.zh: 我捡的是树，不是石头。
lines.en: What I pick up are trees, not stones.

lines.zh: 这株苗我带着走，找块空地种下。
lines.en: I carry this sapling to plant in an open spot.

lines.zh: 我手里握不住，就改用两条手臂。
lines.en: One hand cannot hold it, so I use both arms.

lines.zh: 我把你的东西放在树桩上。
lines.en: I leave your belongings on the stump.

lines.zh: 林子里有东西在动，不是风。
lines.en: Something in the woods is moving, and it is not wind.

lines.zh: 你砍树的声音，传得很远。
lines.en: The sound of your axe carries a long way.

lines.zh: 有人进了我的林子，我闻到了。
lines.en: Someone has entered my woods; I smell them.

lines.zh: 那只鹿跑了，跑的方向就是你那边。
lines.en: The deer ran, and it ran toward you.

lines.zh: 我看见树下有个小小的影子。
lines.en: I see a small shadow beneath the trees.

lines.zh: 你踩断枯枝，我就知道你在这里。
lines.en: You snapped a dry twig, so I know you are here.

lines.zh: 这一片本来很安静，是你打破了。
lines.en: This place was quiet until you broke it.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛从树皮里睁开，看向你。
lines.en: My eyes open from the bark and turn toward you.

lines.zh: 我记住了你的味道，跑不掉的。
lines.en: Your scent is in my bark; running is useless.

lines.zh: 你在两棵树之间停下，那是个错误。
lines.en: You stopped between two trees — a mistake.

lines.zh: 目标不大，但我不会放过。
lines.en: The target is small, but I will not let it pass.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转身，先让你听见声音。
lines.en: I turn slowly, letting you hear me first.

lines.zh: 我一步能跨过这段距离。
lines.en: One stride will cover that distance.

lines.zh: 你躲在树后，树可挡不住我。
lines.en: You hide behind a trunk; a trunk will not stop me.

lines.zh: 我抬起脚，先看准落点。
lines.en: I lift my foot, aiming the landing first.

lines.zh: 你后退的方向，正好是我要走的路。
lines.en: The way you retreat is exactly the way I walk.

lines.zh: 我不急，你跑不出这片林子。
lines.en: I am in no hurry; you cannot leave these woods.

lines.zh: 我把枝冠压低，挡住你的去路。
lines.en: I lower my crown to block your escape.

lines.zh: 你数着距离，我只数步数。
lines.en: You measure in feet; I measure in strides.

lines.zh: 我的影子先到，然后才是脚。
lines.en: My shadow arrives first, then my foot.

lines.zh: 你举起盾，我就从上面砸下来。
lines.en: Raise your shield, and I come down from above.

lines.zh: 我盯住你的膝盖，那里最容易断。
lines.en: I fix on your knees; they break most easily.

lines.zh: 我把你逼到那棵倒树前。
lines.en: I drive you back toward that fallen tree.

lines.zh: 再走两步，你就没地方躲了。
lines.en: Two more steps and you have nowhere left to hide.

lines.zh: 我的拳头落下，土都翻了起来。
lines.en: My fist comes down and the soil turns over.

lines.zh: 这一掌够你记一整年。
lines.en: This blow will stay with you a whole year.

lines.zh: 我不用武器，我的手臂就够。
lines.en: I need no weapon; my arm is enough.

lines.zh: 你被扫中了，飞出去撞在树上。
lines.en: The sweep catches you and throws you into a tree.

lines.zh: 我的树皮硬，你的剑会卷刃。
lines.en: My bark is hard; your blade will notch.

lines.zh: 我每打一下，林子就静一分。
lines.en: With every blow, the forest goes quieter.

lines.zh: 这一脚踩下去，你的盾裂了。
lines.en: This stomp lands, and your shield splits.

lines.zh: 我不想杀你，可你砍了树。
lines.en: I do not want to kill you, but you cut trees.

lines.zh: 我的指节擦过你，你就倒了。
lines.en: My knuckles graze you, and you go down.

lines.zh: 站起来吧，我还没打完。
lines.en: Stand up — I have not finished with you.

lines.zh: 老林深处，树干裂开，我走了出来。
lines.en: Deep in the old woods a trunk splits, and I step out.

lines.zh: 这片森林长得够密，我才肯现身。
lines.en: Only where the forest grows thick will I appear.

lines.zh: 我从一株百年老树里站起来。
lines.en: I rise out of a hundred-year-old tree.

lines.zh: 树根拔出地面，泥土簌簌地落。
lines.en: Roots pull free of the ground, and soil patters down.

lines.zh: 林子需要一个人守着，那就是我。
lines.en: The woods need a keeper, and that keeper is me.

lines.zh: 我不常出现，一出现就是这片林子的主人。
lines.en: I seldom appear, but when I do I own these woods.

lines.zh: 我的第一口气，是树叶的味道。
lines.en: My first breath tastes of leaves.

lines.zh: 鸟先飞走了，然后我才走出来。
lines.en: The birds left first; only then did I step out.

lines.zh: 这一带的老树告诉我要醒了。
lines.en: The old trees here told me it was time to wake.

lines.zh: 我没生下来，我是长出来的。
lines.en: No one bore me; I simply grew.

lines.zh: 火顺着我的枝子爬，很疼。
lines.en: Fire climbs my branches, and it hurts.

lines.zh: 我倒下时，压断了一片小树。
lines.en: When I fell, I crushed a patch of saplings.

lines.zh: 水漫到我的根，我动不了。
lines.en: Water reaches my roots, and I cannot move.

lines.zh: 一声巨响，我的半边身子没了。
lines.en: A blast, and half of my body is gone.

lines.zh: 箭钉在我胸口，像根刺。
lines.en: An arrow juts from my chest like a splinter.

lines.zh: 那股力气把我从土里拔了起来。
lines.en: That force pulls me up out of the soil.

lines.zh: 土里没有养分，我的叶子黄了。
lines.en: The soil has no strength left; my leaves yellow.

lines.zh: 雷劈中我的枝冠，我烧了半边。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my crown and half of me burns.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，我落进黑暗里。
lines.en: The ground is gone, and I fall into darkness.
